title: How to Route Images with the OpenAI Decisions API
summary: Route each image in a Roboflow Workflow to one branch with the OpenAI Decisions Switch block: it prompts GPT-6 Luna and runs the case that clears a probability threshold.
body_markdown:
The OpenAI Decisions Switch block routes each image in a[Roboflow Workflow](https://roboflow.com/blog/workflows?ref=blog.roboflow.com) to one branch. It prompts GPT-6 Luna on the OpenAI Decisions API with one multiple-choice question about the image, then runs the branch whose answer clears a probability threshold. The two examples below sort items on a recycling line and dispatch road crews based on the air temperature.


## How the switch works


The answer options are your cases plus a built-in "none of these", and the API returns a probability for each.


How the switch routes one photo, with the cases from Example 2


## Example 1: sort a recycling line


[RF-DETR instance segmentation](https://roboflow.com/blog/rf-detr-segmentation?ref=blog.roboflow.com) segments and tracks every item on the belt. The switch gets a crop of each item, outlined in magenta so overlapping items don't confuse it, and picks one of six streams: PET, HDPE, film, multilayer, paper or aluminum.


RF-DETR tracks each item on the belt, and the OpenAI Decisions API picks its stream


The video calls the Decisions API directly to draw the probabilities, checks each item three times as it moves, and averages the answers. Gray tags mark items whose top stream stayed below 0.5.


## Example 2: add non-image data with context


Crews pave[potholes](https://roboflow.com/blog/pothole-detection?ref=blog.roboflow.com) with hot asphalt only in warm weather (10 °C or above here) and use cold patch otherwise. The photo can't show the temperature, so the workflow takes` air_temperature_c` from a weather feed and passes it in` context` . The case descriptions refer to it by name. For example,` cold_patch` reads: "The road has potholes or a broken surface but air_temperature_c is below 10, too cold for hot asphalt, so fill them with cold patch for now."


Results at` min_confidence` 0.8:


Photo Air temperature (°C) Model's answer Probability What ran


Pothole on a rural road 20 hot_asphalt_repair 0.99 Paving crew


The same photo 4 cold_patch 0.95 Pothole patrol


Dry, intact asphalt 20 none of these 0.65 Nothing


Close-up of snow with tire tracks -3 spread_salt 0.65 Nothing (below 0.8)


The same pothole at two temperatures, and a dry road that matched no case


The snow close-up scored 0.65 for spread_salt, below 0.8, so nothing ran. In production, route` default_next_steps` to a dispatcher.` context` accepts any workflow value, such as a sensor reading, OCR text or a detection count.


## Block settings


A case runs when it is the top answer and its probability is at least` min_confidence` (default 0.9). Otherwise the image goes to` default_next_steps` , or the workflow stops if that list is empty. At most one branch runs per image.


You set a **question** , the **cases** (each pointing at the first step of its branch), a one-sentence **case_descriptions** entry per case, and optional **context** : named values sent with the image as JSON, for facts the image can't show.


If a detector can make the decision, a[model cascade](https://roboflow.com/blog/model-cascades-for-computer-vision?ref=blog.roboflow.com) is cheaper.


## Choosing min_confidence


Raising` min_confidence` trades wrong routes for more photos in review. We measured it on 100 photos from a public garbage dataset, with its six classes as cases.


Garbage Classification on Roboflow Universe · 6 classes · GPT-6 Luna on the Decisions API


Set it by the cost of a wrong route. An unsure recycling item stays on the belt for the[manual sorters](https://roboflow.com/blog/human-in-the-loop-ai?ref=blog.roboflow.com) , so 0.5 is enough. A wrong road dispatch sends a crew out for nothing, so that workflow uses 0.8. To see probabilities while tuning, run the OpenAI Decisions block in questions mode with the same question; its` answers` output lists each option's probability.


## Try it


1. Add the **OpenAI Decisions Switch** block to a workflow and connect` images` .
2. Write the question, add one case per action, and describe each in one sentence.
3. Set **Default Next Steps** and **Min Confidence** .
4. Test on real photos with sinks disabled (wire a` dry_run` input to each sink's` disable_sink` ). If good photos land in review, fix the descriptions before lowering the threshold.


The block bills Roboflow credits by default, or your own OpenAI key. Each photo is one request with a few hundred to a few thousand input tokens.
